India Boosts Defence Spending and Indigenous Manufacturing

India's Defence Ministry has approved significant military purchases totaling over ₹1 lakh crore, with a strong emphasis on indigenous procurement. This includes substantial investments in missile and air defence systems, alongside a new defence manufacturing facility by Adani Group in Madhya Pradesh. These moves aim to bolster national security and promote self-reliance in defence production.
